assessment.reason: Mobile songbook, request queue, previews, PWA and guest controls: The native capability API and usrelay cover the chosen architecture; no parallel HTTP/UI server is imported into the game. Artist jumps in folder sorting and modifier keys: Current artist-jump matching still uses Folder in folder sorting and exact left-modifier checks; the focused adaptation is tracked separately. macOS Option artwork and local signing identity: These independent UI/build changes are absent from the current skin resolver and packaging targets. Mic tap/voice ownership, achievements and winning streaks: Follow-ups belong to the existing native API/usrelay work. The UPlayerSlots five-second rescan fix is specific to the fork's capture loop, which USCE does not contain. Chart generation: Local automatic chart/stem generation and music acquisition were explicitly ruled out. Generator fixes and LRCLIB/download integration do not change that decision. Editor voice pitch display and controls: Vocals pitch preview remains in the existing editor proposal. Fork-specific generator UI, octave policy and hard-coded shortcuts are not imported. Editor microphone capture: The current editor still starts capture unconditionally; Bluetooth profile changes require verification while preserving optional live pitch feedback. Rapid-seek planar-audio crash report: USCE still uses swr_convert. Reproduction and decoder/frame-lifetime analysis are required before adopting a custom planar converter. Fatal exception reports: Main-loop persistence is already covered by #105 and macOS already resolves modules/symbols. Fatal worker-thread coverage is a separate follow-up. Long instrumental-gap countdown: An optional, themeable, per-voice version is proposed without changing current singing-display settings.
assessment.scope: Static assessment of the full pinned branch comparison; feature grouping and existing USCE decisions, not runtime acceptance.
